summary: Standards pass: a mutation probe of fed0cd14 on a scratch copy (27 mutations of checks.rs; 20 caught, 2 compile errors, 1 equivalent) left atip-check's 79 tests green for six value-level edges that the per-condition test (56) cannot see because it skips a whole condition, not a predicate's value: L0.page accepting any '--cursor' word whatever its value (checker.md 6.9: '--cursor <nextCursor>'), L0.page not accepting or not testing the '--cursor=<v>' form, the stderr 'carries an error' test reduced to JSON-with-ok only (the error/data forms and the bare code-in-text form are unplanted), L0.no-env-switch-text compared only for CI (TERM, NO_COLOR and the terminal variation of text mode unplanted), L0.unknown-command accepting 'expected': [] (only a missing member is planted), and L0.version accepting exit 2 (only exit 1 is planted). Every condition is covered; the survivors are value edges. Blast radius: canon and lute use a green run as an L0 claim, and none of these is on the path of a conforming tool. Fix: one config per edge (a wrong cursor value, an empty expected, text-mode TERM=dumb switching to JSON).
